value.rationale: A classical rational interpolation method may keep monotone data in a uniformly bounded range while its interpolated Jordan variation diverges. The first-order sharp logarithmic stability constant across all mesh sizes, with an explicit simple step lower bound, resolves a natural input-to-output BV question, rather than an incidental small example.
